name: IMG_4309.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The architect presents both volumes as one continuous system, with neither complete independently. The original single release is stated as 1,043 pages before an adequate index; the split keeps continuous pagination and places a technical glossary at the end of volume two. The author introduces Alchemystic Cosmodynamics as the broader name and criticizes myth-based and subjective astrology. These are the author's methodological and publishing claims, not independent evidence of scientific or predictive validity.
visual_observations: Header ARCHITECT'S NOTE, Roman v.
Two outlined triangle emblems flank title; no calculation diagram.
The stated original length is 1,043, not an assigned scan denominator.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Both volumes form one unified system and should be consulted together.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Publication scope; do not infer that the acquired scan corpus is complete.

name: IMG_4310.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The author defines the project as rebuilding an allegedly broken practice through celestial mechanics and observed life outcomes. Five stated standards are observation, testability and repeatability, predictive or explanatory power, consistent rules and definitions, and independence from authority. Validity is said to arise from evidence rather than belief, tradition or status. The page requests use of the new field name Alchemystic Cosmodynamics. It asserts scientific standing without supplying a validation dataset or controlled test here.
visual_observations: Header vi, I FIXED ASTROLOGY.
Five visibly distinct bullet points; no empirical results table.
Cosmo definition continues onto the next photograph.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Claims should be assessable by observation, repeatability, consistent definitions and evidence independent of authority.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Methodological standard only; this page does not prove the claims meet it.

name: IMG_4311.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: Cosmodynamics is described as celestial structure, motion, interaction and effects over time, explicitly distinguished from mythology and archetypal storytelling. The architect's note was reportedly added after the first few hundred copies. Existing Alchemystic Astrology wording is intentionally retained but should be understood as the renamed framework. Most importantly for implementation, the author says these volumes establish architecture and mechanics rather than a step-by-step application manual; workshops and the Mystic Circle learning community supply further instruction.
visual_observations: Header ARCHITECT'S NOTE, vii.
Explicit negation: volumes are not a step-by-step application manual.
Earlier name intentionally remains in the printed body.

assertion_candidates.proposition: The treatise defines a framework rather than a complete step-by-step application manual.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Do not invent missing application rules merely because the author claims a coherent framework.

name: IMG_4312.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The note closes by treating discovery as ongoing and the author's understanding as capable of refinement. Readers carrying the work onward are framed as stewards of precision and coherence rather than followers. It urges thoughtful use of knowledge and changes in circumstances, connecting intention to action. The content is an exhortation and an explicit opening to later refinement, with no new chart calculation, timing rule or diagnostic test on this page.
visual_observations: Header viii, I FIXED ASTROLOGY.
Large blank lower region is visible; one page, not a missing second page.
Closing lines emphasize intention and operation without a numerical procedure.

assertion_candidates.proposition: The author's framework remains subject to continuing discovery and refinement.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: General methodological stance; no automatic permission to revise a conflicting rule silently.

name: IMG_4313.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: This acknowledgements page credits the author's wife with encouraging spiritual exploration and investigation of doubt. It describes the author's personal survival-mode history and appreciates three children through specific family stories. These first-person experiences establish the author's stated motivation and family acknowledgements only. No chart factors, birth data, aspect geometry or repeatable inference connects those experiences to placements here, so they must not become general biographical claims about readers or reusable predictive rules.
visual_observations: Header ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, xi; Gemini emblems flank heading.
Names and family stories are personal acknowledgements.
Final paragraph continues below/onto another page.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Personal acknowledgements are autobiographical source context rather than chart-derived interpretive evidence.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Do not transfer the author's family or trauma history to a user.

name: IMG_4314.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The acknowledgements continue with personal accounts of children, adoptive parents, brother and friend. One limited interpretive example says the author's late father was intelligent despite a Mercury-in-Pisces stereotype; for Scorpio rising the author calls that Mercury truly Leo, anticipating the house-field distinction explained elsewhere. This is an author-specific illustration, not a universal intelligence rule. Adoption age and family descriptions are reported autobiography without chart evidence or a reusable derivation on this page.
visual_observations: Header xii, I FIXED ASTROLOGY.
Author states adoption at six and a half.
Mercury Pisces / truly Leo / Scorpio rising occur in one example.

assertion_candidates.proposition: The author's Mercury-in-Pisces family example rejects an isolated sign stereotype.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Do not assert intelligence, adoption or family circumstances from this example.

name: IMG_4315.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The author responds to a friend's determinism objection by stating that stars provide form rather than control and that free will remains available. Most of the page recounts alleged hostility, rejection and organized criticism, alongside gratitude toward supporters and teachers. Those accusations and personal accounts remain claims within an acknowledgement, not independently established events or astrological indications. The reusable boundary is that interpretation must leave room for choice rather than presenting celestial factors as compulsory behavior.
visual_observations: Header ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, xiii.
Explicit negation: stars do not control people.
No chart or aspect values.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Celestial form does not remove a person's ability to exercise free will.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Allegations are autobiographical claims, not chart rules.

name: IMG_4316.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The author credits caring teachers and a martial arts instructor, describing Mystic Circle as a lifelong learning school analogous to progression through martial arts belts. Clients and students are praised as evidence of value in the author's own account, but no outcome measurements or controls are shown. Astrology is also described as a stepping stone rather than the whole of the author's identity or purpose. The page supports a learning philosophy and personal motivation, not a newly validated calculation.
visual_observations: Header xiv, I FIXED ASTROLOGY.
White belt to black belt is an educational analogy.
Client validity claim has no accompanying sample.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Study is framed as lifelong development rather than a fixed identity or final destination.

name: IMG_4317.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The acknowledgement rejects accepting only what subjectively resonates and emphasizes asking questions and seeking verification. It then presents a spiritual account of shared consciousness, encourages challenging inherited beliefs and recognizing self-worth, and credits extended conversations with strangers for perceived patterns in natal charts. Those conversations are described as developmental experience, without sampled charts, independent assessments or statistical controls. Verification as an aspiration must remain distinct from proof actually supplied by the source.
visual_observations: Header ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS, xv.
Explicit rejection of take-what-resonates acceptance.
Life-story conversations described; no natal data.

assertion_candidates.proposition: Subjective resonance alone is not an adequate standard for accepting an interpretation.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: Anecdotal pattern discovery is not controlled evidence.

name: IMG_4318.JPG
image_quality: Readable full single-page photograph; mild perspective and show-through.
summary: The page provides a blank drawing template for a natal chart, labeled as a static blueprint. Its wheel has twelve numbered sectors, with house one at the lower-left side of the horizontal axis and house seven opposite, houses four and ten at the bottom and top of the central cross. Concentric outer rings and degree ticks are left unfilled. No planets, signs, native details or aspect lines are supplied; it is a worksheet rather than a completed worked example.
visual_observations: Header CHARTS, xvii.
Blank twelve-house wheel, degree ticks and concentric rings.
H1 lower-left; H4 bottom; H7 upper-right; H10 top.

assertion_candidates.proposition: This worksheet distinguishes the natal chart as a static blueprint.
assertion_candidates.exclusions_and_limits: No individual's placements or calculation method supplied.
